business_problem: Rongshan Technology was tackling highly fragmented personal-loan nonperforming assets with labor-intensive manual teams, low customer reach, and growing compliance exposure. The company needed a full-process AI approach that could automate outreach, understand intent, analyze dialogs for risk, and maintain standardized operations from first contact through repayment and dispute resolution.
solution_summary: Rongshan Technology built its asset-disposal workflow on Alibaba Cloud around Tongyi Xiaomi's smart outbound robot and intelligent dialog analysis. The architecture combines Rongshan's own asset-management system, large-model outbound-call system, and data-analysis system with cloud-based AI services so the company can automate outreach, online agreement signing, repayment follow-up, and arbitration mediation in one flow. Digital mediators driven by the outbound robot interpret customer intent, perform emotional analysis, and produce compliant settlement options, while intelligent dialog analysis continuously inspects outbound interactions for quality and regulatory risk. Around those business functions, Rongshan uses an elastic cloud-native deployment model for its AI workloads so compute can scale with asset volume without forcing the company to overbuild fixed infrastructure. The result is an AI-first collections and settlement pipeline rather than a manually stitched process.

solution_components.name: Tongyi Xiaomi smart outbound robot
solution_components.role: Automates outreach and drives the digital mediator interactions used in debt-settlement workflows.

solution_components.name: Intelligent dialog analysis
solution_components.role: Inspects outbound-call data for quality and compliance risk and feeds warnings back into operations.

solution_components.name: Asset-management system
solution_components.role: Provides the structured case and asset context used by the AI workflow.

solution_components.name: Large-model AI outbound system
solution_components.role: Runs the model-driven conversation layer used for outreach and negotiation tasks.

data_flow: Asset and case data from the management system is fed into the large-model outbound layer, where Tongyi Xiaomi digital mediators contact borrowers, classify intent, and recommend settlement actions. Call transcripts are then analyzed by the dialog-analysis layer to flag risk, support follow-up, and drive the later steps of signing, repayment tracking, and arbitration mediation.
business_outcome: Rongshan transformed collections and dispute-handling into a more standardized AI workflow. Compared with manual operations, daily customer reach improved 20x and repayment recovery improved more than 5x, while the cloud-based quality-control layer reduced compliance exposure and let the business scale without matching growth in headcount.
architecture_clues: The workflow spans outreach, signing, repayment, and arbitration instead of limiting AI to only one collections step.
Customer intent recognition and emotion analysis are embedded directly into the outbound robot rather than handled offline.
Dialog analysis is used as a compliance-control layer over operational calls.
AI models are deployed in a cloud-native elastic mode so compute can scale with asset volume.
